facts.text: UAE retail lending is predominantly variable-rate priced off EIBOR; the repayment burden on variable-rate facilities moves with the rate environment, so long-tenor exposure opened in a low-rate period can carry payment shock later.

Central Bank of the UAE retail lending rules cap the debt burden ratio at 50% of gross salary and personal loans at 20 times salary; facilities granted near these ceilings leave little absorption room.

Income stability differs structurally by sector in the UAE: government and government-related employment is salaried and comparatively stable; construction and contracting income is project-cyclical; hospitality and retail trade are seasonal and demand-sensitive.
